message: Imported and analyzed source rows; exact duplicates counted once.

methodology.role_discovery: Lossless grouping by identical observed permission sets
methodology.optimization: Exact coverage with one candidate role per equivalence class; minimizes role count under this representation
methodology.risk: Dataset-relative rarity and permission density; not a business impact or exploitability score
methodology.reinforcement_learning: Offline tabular Q-learning recommendation; actions are counterfactual and require human approval
methodology.data_scope: Access-control matrix only; no live ERP or AWS actions
